question: Choose the correct **one-word substitute** for: 'One who writes traditional poems'.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'** i.e. '**Bard**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **Bard** refers to a poet especially one who composes traditional or epic poems. (कवि विशेषकर पारंपरिक कवि)

 
 
• **Example:** The village bard recited heroic tales of ancient warriors.
 
 
 
• **Bard** is often used for poets who narrate legends and cultural stories in verse form. (गाथा गायक कवि)
 
 
• **Example:** He was known as a bard who preserved history through poetry.
 
 
 
• Thus bard is the correct one word substitute for a person who writes traditional poem.

Therefore the correct answer is Option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meaning.

 
• **Lyricist** (गीतकार): A person who writes the words of songs.
 
• **Dramatist** (नाटककार): A writer of plays or dramas.
 
• **Essayist** (निबंधकार): A person who writes essays.
